    AI Overview
    Yes,
    Landman has been officially renewed for a third season by Paramount+, with a release expected in November 2026    . The renewal follows massive viewership for season 2, which became one of the platform's most-watched original series. The 10-episode season 3 is expected to continue focusing on the Norris family, with production starting around April/May 2026. 
    This video provides a summary of the confirmed details for the upcoming third season:
    36s
    Looper
    YouTube • Feb 2, 2026
    Key Details About Season 3: 
    • Release Window: November 2026 is the expected release date.
    • Production:
      Filming for the third season is set to begin in April 2026
      .
    • Cast: Billy Bob Thornton is confirmed to return as Tommy Norris, having signed a multi-year contract.
    • Plot: The new season will likely feature a "reset" for the characters, with Tommy, T.L., and Cooper working together in a new family-run business, according to this Hollywood Reporter article.
    • Storyline: The upcoming season is expected to explore Ainsley's, played by Michelle Randolph, storyline at TCU.
